I am Cat Matlock at FreeBody Massage, and I am here for your educational needs.  As a massage therapist with 30+ years of experience, I want to support you being the best massage therapist you can be.  I specialize in trigger point massage and helping people learn the skills to get themselves out of pain.  

I am a practicing massage therapist in Asheville, NC, and teach Continuing Education classes, both online and in-person.  You can find my CE courses HERE ----  https://www.freebodynow.com/ce-courses/

And Get a FREE 1CE Course on Body Mechanics here ----  https://freebodynow.kartra.com/page/ce-body-mechanics

Have Fun!  Keep Learning!  Be Awesome!
